summary: Optional: base-vs-finetune entanglement audit using idle homology extraction infra
description: The rellm-homology module's residual-stream extraction infra (src/rellm/homology/, tools/homology_extract.py) is sitting idle after the concept-direction-as-edge-source method failed its own gate (see rellm docs/homology/findings.md) — but the extraction machinery itself still works and merged qwen-3-4b-guru checkpoints exist under out/qwen3-4b-guru*/merged/. A base-vs-finetuned entanglement audit (how much does fine-tuning perturb concept-direction geometry per layer) was floated as a cheap secondary use — optional, not blocking anything, worth doing only if it's cheap relative to whatever else is queued. Could double as an informal v3 regression-test signal ('did this retrain change the model's internal geometry more than expected') rather than a formal ship gate.
